verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an official MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags and debug targeting, so users can operate it in natural language through an external AI assistant. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface in the product itself, and coverage is limited to flag creation, management and targeting debugging. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented scope of operations beyond flags/targeting, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
Check why a user gets or doesn't get a flag.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/mcp
